---
title: "A measured page image sizes og:image only"
image: page.png
_quarto:
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: 'twitter-card.*ignored'
        negate: true
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '<meta name="twitter:image" content="https://example.com/page.png">'
          - '<meta property="og:image:height" content="160">'
          - '<meta property="og:image:width" content="210">'
        -
          - 'twitter:image-height'
          - 'twitter:image-width'
          - 'twitter:image:height'
          - 'twitter:image:width'
---

Twitter Cards have no image size tags, so the measured size of this PNG goes to Open Graph only.
